Here is the brief reasoning for each question:

1. **[id 906d88eb-ed62-45ad-ab5e-8ab3185bf4c1-126173]**: Adenine and guanine are purine bases, while cytosine, thymine, and uracil are pyrimidines. **(A)**
2. **[id 90f11471-cd6d-446e-b0eb-cf27a9525d6d-24543]**: $H = \frac{(u \sin\theta)^2}{2g} = \frac{(29.4 \times \sin 30^\circ)^2}{2 \times 9.8} = \frac{14.7^2}{19.6} = 11.025\text{ m}$. **(B)**
3. **[id 9122ae5d-a936-4516-8f49-ab251780dcc2-113224]**: Carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) is the principal anthropogenic contributor driving global warming. **(A)**
4. **[id 9153ac5e-47de-4086-b971-be92a887b857-103947]**: Stopping distance $s \propto v^2$. Doubling velocity increases stopping distance by $2^2 = 4$ times. **(A)**
5. **[id 939c4886-bccc-468d-9758-e738c3fba007-130745]**: Tropical rainforests possess the highest plant and animal biodiversity among terrestrial biomes. **(B)**
6. **[id 957893bc-7177-435b-8a2f-22e56f6c8d81-41482]**: Coat Protein (CP) genes are inserted to provide viral disease resistance in transgenic crops. **(A)**
7. **[id 95c4bdea-8802-44ff-ae5b-1690fbf85769-39004]**: $\text{Area} = \int_0^2 3x \, dx = \left[ \frac{3x^2}{2} \right]_0^2 = 6$. **(D)**
8. **[id 962b2725-3aee-468f-adb1-e5ee3fa91e3e-50321]**: Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman transmitted the declaration of independence in the early hours of March 26 via EPR wireless. **(C)**
9. **[id 9698a244-753b-4144-91ea-dde0a7ab5302-127225]**: Boron shares a diagonal relationship with Silicon in the periodic table. **(A)**
10. **[id 975edc8c-78bd-485b-94af-265b38beec84-67491]**: Hydrogen gas ($\text{H}_2$, molar mass $\approx 2\text{ g/mol}$) is the lightest gas. **(A)**
11. **[id 9794574e-702e-46e6-9aaa-14092809e414-122849]**: The passive voice follows the rule: *Let + object + be + past participle + by + me*. **(C)**
12. **[id 98128531-5358-4528-8082-537d39bc9e75-3746]**: Following the CHT Peace Accord, the Shanti Bahini formally disbanded on March 5, 1998. **(A)**
13. **[id 9901d520-d787-402f-96ff-683966d32b79-143197]**: $\text{C}_2\text{H}_2 + 2.5\text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{CO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$; $100\text{ ml} \times 2.5 = 250\text{ ml}$ of $\text{O}_2$. **(D)**
14. **[id 997465ad-58cd-4f94-9aff-d01a798b64c8-61569]**: Giant molecules (macromolecules/polymers) are characterized by very high molecular weight/mass (আণবিক ভর অত্যাধিক). **(C)**
15. **[id 99c0678c-cf2d-47a5-a32c-de69d3247ef7-16406]**: Hypotenuse $= \sqrt{8^2 + 6^2} = 10$; circumradius of a right-angled triangle $= \text{hypotenuse} / 2 = 5$. **(B)**
